atoms.b: Brandon used ((++an_indefinite_pronoun a_possessive_pronoun)) because he ((does ++doesn’t)) personally know the lady who gave him the flower.
((++Indefinite Object)) pronouns are used when something or someone ((++doesn’t_need needs)) to be specifically referred to.

hint.text:
Try forming sentences in your head with the indefinite pronouns. Make sure to look at the context of the sentence.

If you’re stuck, select the pronouns to hear example sentences.

atoms.sound: We can each decide what we like best.
Anybody can be the best version of themselves.
Many go on a run at the beginning of the New Year.
No one truly knows how many spiders they swallow while sleeping per year.
Did you let the others know about the barbecue party?
Everyone knows stereotypes can be harmful.
Few have been to the moon.

Some of your students ((++are is)) especially interested in physics.
Everyone forgot about the costume party we wanted to ((has ++have)).
Someone else ((++is are)) wearing the exact same jacket as you are.
Several streets ((++are is)) blocked due to construction.
Everybody can all finally ((++go going)) canoeing together.
